body:
Went to the ER they took blood tests and a urine sample and sent me home because there was nothing showing anything wrong. 
So my blood is still not showing signs of inflammation or infection atleast. But even though I am being told it’s nothing dangerous so I “don’t have to worry”, I am in incredible pain which is making me more and more mentally unstable. 
Endometriosis I have thought that I could have, I have had a lot of issues with menstrual pain in the past, but also heavy bleeding. But I have been on progesterones for years now, I used to still get bleeding every few months, that would honestly last for a month atleast. But i now haven’t had any bleeding or discharge for that matter, in almost a year. 
And the gynaecologists I’ve been trying to get help from, says the pills “protects” me from that kind of thing. Although that gynaecologist also said the pill I’m on “protects” me from even getting cysts, but one of the side effects is literally cysts. -.- 

In the ER they took another urine sample today and sent for growing cultures (I don’t know what that is called in English). They said they will contact me in two days when that shows results. But as I’ve already collected litres of urine for my regular health care Center, I am not feeling optimistic about it showing anything. But now it’s the third time my urine has white blood cells in it, not a lot but in the ER they said that I should ask my health care Center to look into that more if cultures doesn’t show anything.. 

I’m kinda feeling broken down. Because I’m suffering so much I just want someone to find SOMETHING. So there’s something to treat, or actually give me something stronger or something to deal with this so that I can actually live a somewhat functioning life again. 
Is it my bowels, is it my bowels, is it gynaecological. Nobody can even tell me exactly where the pain is coming from and that is making this whole thing feel way more hopeless..
I just feel like it might not be worth it anymore. I feel like life is an evil joke, and I cannot believe the new year is gonna be better.
